# Gemma 4 E4B

Google · released 2026-04 · 8B params (4.5B active) · apache-2.0

**score 54.4** ±0.9 · #209 of 549 · from 25 benchmark results across 6 sources

## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

<sub>[context source](https://github.com/anomalyco/models.dev/blob/a668908cfe7073faa0363699486fc41a3ff52412/models/google/gemma-4-E4B-it.toml): model catalogue context ceiling (not a promise by a hosted API)</sub>

<pre>
download         size  score
4-bit q4_k_m   ~5.3GB   54.4
4-bit QAT qat  ~5.3GB   54.4
</pre>

```sh
# 4-bit q4_k_m
ollama run gemma4:e4b
# 4-bit QAT qat
ollama run gemma4:e4b-it-qat
```

<sub>The score is the published model's; quantized downloads haven't been evaluated separately.</sub>
